■Features
-Warning Notification【Only applicable to the vehicles equipped with Connected DA.】
“ZEED T-Connect “informs you if a malfunction occurs in your vehicle. 
You can immediately get in touch with our call center.
 
-Driving Data【Only applicable to the vehicles equipped with Connected DA.】
“ZEED T-Connect “keeps you informed about your vehicle's condition.
Easily check Mileage and Driving Time on your smartphone. You can check driving conditions.

Note:
To obtain vehicle information through the Connected DA, your smartphone needs to be connected to the Connected DA via Bluetooth, and the ZEED T-Connect app needs to be running.
The vehicle information is transmitted to the TOYOTA server in conjunction with GPS when the app is running. It is not reflected properly on the app if GPS is disabled on your smartphone.
